# Mantis Alien

> Mantis Alien is an anonymous masked DJ and electronic music project. It is not a person but an archetype and a role: there is only ever one Mantis visible; when a mask falls, another rises. It presents LIBER: El Libro Rojo, a continuous 11-track, 61-minute melodic house and trance journey through Carl Jung's Red Book (Liber Novus).

- Identity: unknown by design. Mantis Alien never appears without the helmet and never gives spoken interviews.
- Origin myth: landed at latitude 0° (the equator, Ecuador) carrying a red book and a question, answering Jung's 1958 book on UFOs as a modern myth.
- Signature: helmet with acid-green (#39FF6A) LED eyes. Every set ends with "XI Individuation".
- Answer to "who are you?": "Nadie. Soy lo que niegas." (Nobody. I am what you deny.)
- Production: AI-assisted (Suno), with human direction and curation.
